name: Java: 1Z0-811 Java Foundations (Oracle)
material_vintage: Oracle University 1Z0-811 Java Foundations exam topics, fetched live on 2026-09-26 from the Oracle MyLearn exam page and itemised in full: every listed objective in each of the 13 areas is one item. Exam format as published: multiple choice; 60 questions; 120 minutes; passing score 65%. Oracle publishes no area weights and no past papers: every item here is original. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by compiling and running the code (javac/java, JDK 21).
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level

learner_notices.text: The 1Z0-811 page does not name a Java SE version. The course teaches the syllabus with classic syntax that compiles on any modern JDK; newer features (var, arrow-form switch, records) are left to java_se21_developer.
